title: Bounded prime labels and auxiliary padding
objective: Attempt an actual parity-sensitive polynomial-roughness estimate through a bounded-label or externally padded adaptation, preserving exact source hypotheses and obtaining either a reviewed useful bound or a precise failure of those constructions without redefining the Goldbach objective.
deliverables: Inspected exact source definitions and parameter ranges
At most two constructive label or padding attempts
Independent exact support and transfer checks
Claim ledger and concrete next decision
success_criteria: A claimed gain is an actual proved estimate, not an assumed cancellation hypothesis
Zero bias is not falsely imported at a polynomial roughness cutoff
Padding retains coprimality, primitivity and moving-target conditions explicitly
Finite algebra does not certify the external analytic theorem
The actual Goldbach objective remains incomplete unless its required result is proved and verified
stop_conditions: One six-stage round within 20 dispatch proxy units
No separately billed provider or external mutable action
Preserve the exact failure of an adaptation rather than generalize it to every possible method
